en.topic_title: Wild pigs and pampered pooches: Hong Kong’s complex relationship with animals
en.topic_summary:
“Some we love, some we hate, some we eat,” was the title of a best-selling exploration of the relationship between humans and animals, with subtitle “Why it’s so hard to think straight about animals.”



Pixel the HKFP dog. Photo: HKFP.



The spectrum actually goes much wider than love, hatred and food. It includes animals as tourist attractions, animals as a mechanism for gambling, animals as laboratory subjects, and (still) animals as workers. And so on.
